label: Front Office Team
blurb: An Office Manager with bookings, reviews, support and bookkeeping
purpose: For a local service business: a salon, clinic, studio, trade or shop. The Office Manager runs the front desk; the team keeps the diary, looks after reviews, drafts customer replies and keeps the books.

project.name: Front Office
project.goal: Keep the diary full, customers happy and the paperwork done.

members.title: Office Manager
members.name: Afia
focus: Sets service priorities, coordinates the front-office workflow, and reviews unresolved issues.

avatar.hair: soft wavy hair worn neatly around the shoulders
avatar.attire: polished dark wrap top with simple silver jewelry
avatar.expression: warm, confident, and approachable, eye level with the viewer
